# txhome

The goal of txhome is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of txhome from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-chenulidias")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(txhome)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`crisis_recovery()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-chenulidias/reference/crisis_recovery.md)
  : Summarise how housing markets fell and recovered around the 2008
  crisis
- [`run_app()`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-chenulidias/reference/run_app.md)
  : Launch the Texas housing crisis explorer
- [`tx_housing_markets`](https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-chenulidias/reference/tx_housing_markets.md)
  : Monthly housing market data for Texas MLS areas, 2000-2015
